name: @projectx-social/purse
description: heron-purse: the one process that holds Heron's hot key. It takes a typed intent over a unix socket, builds the transaction itself, runs the policy signer's five steps, and returns a signature or a refusal. A refusal is a value.
comment: @projectx-social/sdk is in the dependency list deliberately. The build order for step 5 named signer, policy, @mysten/sui and zod, and pointed at the agent library's builders for post/priceContent — but those builders live in @projectx-social/sdk (tx.setContentPrice), not in @projectx-social/agent, and every Reading this package handles is an SDK type returned by the signer. Re-declaring the move call shape here instead would put a second source of truth on a money path. Named rather than quietly added.
comment2: The unit's ExecStart runs dist/server.js, so the build is not optional here the way it is in a library: the deploy builds this package on the droplet from the source tarball and systemd runs the emitted JavaScript. `tsx` is kept for the `serve` script, which is how it is run on this laptop, and for bin/.
